I now have the complete picture. Here is the full, ordered list of what happens on `POST /api/owners` (handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`, since the V2 controller only exposes a paged GET).

## Before the method body runs (framework-level)

1. **Authorization** — `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")` requires the caller to hold the `OWNER_ADMIN` role, else `403`.
2. **Bean Validation** of the request body — `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` triggers, on failure returning `400`. Constraints (`OwnerFieldsDto`):
   - `firstName`: `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..30)`, `@Pattern` `^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$` (1–3 letter-words separated by space/apostrophe/hyphen)
   - `lastName`: `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..30)`, `@Pattern` `^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}\.?$` (same, with an optional trailing `.`)
   - `address`: `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..255)`
   - `city`: `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..80)`
   - `telephone`: `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..20)`, `@Pattern` `^[0-9 ()-]*$` (digits, spaces, parens, hyphens only)
   - `email`: optional; `@Size(max = 255)` when present

## Inside `addOwner` (in execution order)

3. **Map** the DTO to an `Owner` entity (`ownerMapper.toOwner`).
4. **Normalize telephone (side-effect / mutation)** — `owner.setTelephone(normalizeTelephone(...))` strips every non-digit, storing digits only (e.g. `"(613) 555-0100"` → `"6135550100"`).
5. **Resolve city (side-effect / mutation)** — `owner.setCity(resolveCity(...))`: if any existing owner is in the same city (case-insensitive), reuse that owner's exact spelling; otherwise title-case the input (`"new york"` → `"New York"`). `null` stays `null`.
6. **Duplicate check → `409 CONFLICT`** if either:
   - `isDuplicateOwner` — an existing owner has the same digits-only telephone, **or**
   - `isDuplicateEmail` — an existing owner has the same email, compared after normalization (trim, collapse internal whitespace, lower-case); blank/null email never matches.
7. **Daily registration limit → `400`** — `isDailyRegistrationLimitReached`: if ≥ 20 owners already have today's registration date.
8. **City capacity → `400`** — `isCityCapacityReached(city)`: if ≥ 8 existing owners are in this city (case-insensitive); `null` city is never at capacity.
